question.problem:
From top to bottom, what are the missing expressions in the following polynomial division problem?

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,\,\,\boxed{} \\  & 2x+1\,\enclose{longdiv}{\,\,2{x}^{2}+7x+0} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,{2{x}^{2}+x}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,6x+0 \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,{\boxed{}}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,-3\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
Notice that the dividend is missing the constant term. So, we write it using a zero coefficient, as follows:

$$
2{x}^{2}+7x+0
$$

Using the method of polynomial division, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,\,\,\,x+3\, \\  & 2x+1\,\enclose{longdiv}{\,\,2{x}^{2}+7x+0} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,{2{x}^{2}+x}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,6x+0 \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,{6x+3}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,-3\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the missing expressions are

$\,$ $x+3\,$ and $\,6x+3.$
